# Panel

Panel: a rounded surface (with a very faint contact shadow in light mode and no border), optionally with a title
row. It holds one complete piece of content such as a table, a list or a form. The title row has the same
horizontal padding as the content; with `flush`, it lines up with the text of the table cells.

**Category**: Patterns · **Common uses**: Wrapping a table or a list; a standalone block of content on a page; one side of a split view

## Import

```ts
import { Panel } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

A panel with a title and actions.

```tsx
import { Button, Panel, Text } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Panel title="Details" actions={<Button size="sm">Edit</Button>}>
      <Text tone="secondary">The content of a panel has a padding of step 4 by default</Text>
    </Panel>
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Flush content

Use `flush` for tables and lists inside a panel, so that the content reaches the edges.

```tsx
import { DataTable, Panel } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Flush() {
  return (
    <Panel flush>
      <DataTable
        aria-label="Projects"
        rowKey={(r) => r.id}
        rows={[{ id: '1', name: 'Website redesign' }]}
        columns={[{ key: 'name', title: 'Name' }]}
      />
    </Panel>
  )
}
```

## Advanced

### Settings panel

```tsx
import { Panel, SettingRow, Switch } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Settings() {
  return (
    <Panel title="Chat">
      <SettingRow
        title="Recall messages"
        description="Messages can be recalled within 2 minutes of sending"
        control={<Switch defaultChecked />}
      />
      <SettingRow title="Read receipts" control={<Switch />} />
    </Panel>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | Panel title; without it, the panel has no title row. | — | No |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` | Actions on the right of the title. | — | No |
| `flush` | `boolean` | Flush content (tables, lists, trees) without padding. | — | No |
| `padding` | `0 \| 1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6 \| 7 \| 8` | Padding step of the content (ignored with `flush`). | `4` | No |
| `fill` | `boolean` | Fills the remaining height of the parent; the content scrolls inside the panel. | — | No |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Contents of the panel. | — | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
